title: Math: 2D and 3D Shapes 🧊
summary:
1. 2D Shapes (Flat)
2D shapes are flat. We sort them by the number of sides and corners.
• 🔵 Circle: 1 curved side, 0 corners.
• Polygons: Flat shapes with straight sides.
- ⬟ Pentagon (5 sides)
- ⬣ Hexagon (6 sides)
- 🛑 Octagon (8 sides)

2. Line of Symmetry 🦋
A line of symmetry is a line that cuts a shape exactly in half. Both sides match perfectly like a mirror!

3. 3D Shapes (Solid)
3D shapes are fat, not flat! They have faces (flat sides), edges, and vertices (corners).
• 🧊 Cube: 6 square faces (like a dice).
• 📦 Cuboid: 6 rectangular faces (like a box).
• 🥫 Cylinder: 2 flat circles and 1 curved face (like a tin can).
• 🎉 Cone: 1 flat circle and 1 curved face coming to a point (like a party hat).

questions.questionText: What is a Line of Symmetry?
options: A line that makes a shape colorful.
A line that cuts a shape into two EXACTLY matching halves.
A line that has no corners.
questions.answer: A line that cuts a shape into two EXACTLY matching halves.
questions.hint: Think of a butterfly's wings. They are perfectly the same on both sides!

questions.questionText: If you fold a perfect Square (🟦) in half, do the two sides match exactly?
options: Yes, it has lines of symmetry.
questions.answer: Yes, it has lines of symmetry.
questions.hint: A square is perfectly even on all sides.
